title: Reproducibility Package for Fine-Tuning Faster R-CNN for Person Detection in Site Surveillance Imagery

creators.name: Kim, S. J.
creators.affiliation: Institute for Industrial Policy Studies (IPS), aSSIST University, Seoul, Republic of Korea

description:
Reproducibility archive for the Machine Vision and Applications manuscript Fine-Tuning Faster R-CNN for Person Detection in Site Surveillance Imagery: A Size-Stratified Evaluation Against an Off-the-Shelf COCO-Pretrained Baseline (S. J. Kim).

The study is a controlled empirical machine-vision study of domain-specific fine-tuning for site-surveillance person detection. This archive contains the training and evaluation code (PyTorch/torchvision), the COCO-format annotations of the public Roboflow "site dataset" (CC BY 4.0), stored test-set detections of all evaluated models, bootstrap outputs, intermediate analysis files (scene clusters, training history and log), figure-generation scripts with the manuscript figures, an inference example, reproduction instructions and a SHA-256 manifest.

Dataset images are not redistributed; they are available from the provider. Trained model weights are not included; their filenames, SHA-256 values, upstream models and redistribution status are documented in docs/MODEL_WEIGHTS.md. The historical scene-held-out checkpoint was not preserved.
